headline: Blackwing Lair in 33:45 with two deaths, both on Nefarian's landing

mvp.headline: the most damage on Vaelastrasz, Broodlord and Chromaggus, top five on all eight
why: First on Vaelastrasz, Broodlord and Chromaggus (115k), second on Firemaw, third on Razorgore, Flamegor and Nefarian

also.text: the most damage on Firemaw and Flamegor and second on four more
every Tranquilizing Shot of the night, 2 on Flamegor and 3 on Chromaggus
18 afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus, 17 of them Black

overview: Eight kills on eight pulls in 33:45, against a usual 47:25. Two boss deaths, Pomo and Malyric to Shadow Flame three and five seconds into Nefarian, and one trash death.

The tranquilizing was one hunter deep. Speldosan took 2 of Flamegor's 4 Frenzies and 3 of Chromaggus' 5, and on Flamegor the other two let Fire Nova hit the raid 432 times, more than twice the usual rate. Nobody died to it.
World buffs were light on Vaelastrasz (17 with Rallying Cry) and back up to 35 by Firemaw.

wentWell.text: Chromaggus in 1:19 with breaths hitting 6 times, against about 65 on a usual kill, and 73 afflictions cleansed.
Firemaw in 0:44 with a parse median of 90 and Flame Buffet stacks at under half the usual.
Nefarian in 1:37 against a usual 2:25, fears at a quarter of the usual rate, parse median 84.

notes.text: 0:25 (median 0:28), no deaths. Alanakos top, Wizness parse 97.
0:28 (median 0:45), no deaths. One Burning Adrenaline, on Mohg.
0:38 (median 0:50), no deaths, Blast Wave hits at half the usual rate.
0:44 (median 1:40), no deaths. Gertggs and Tochopolvo 70k each.
0:52, no deaths, but only 2 of 4 Frenzies tranquilized (both by Speldosan), and Fire Nova did 190k to the raid, 75% of all damage taken.
1:19 (median 1:57), no deaths. 3 of 5 Frenzies tranquilized, all by Speldosan. Elozia cleansed 18 afflictions, Thormund 14, Künigünde 11.
1:37. Pomo (4 Shadow Flames) and Malyric (6) died at 0:03 and 0:05, the only deaths. Miniwrecker top at 139k.
